caption_link.limitation: The source provides matching numeric IDs only. It does not provide an original post URL, date, media link, or an explicit asset-to-caption key.

inspection.evidence_scope: Source-bound start, material-intermediate, and near-complete frames were extracted from the original local GIF and visually inspected at full canvas size; metadata came from that same source file.

motion_sampling.method: Three source-bound frame samples extracted from the original local GIF for review; no derivative was added to the corpus.
motion_sampling.limitation: Three sampled frames establish the observed state change, not a frame-by-frame reconstruction of timing or platform playback.

visual_anatomy.title: A central numerical phrase is held in a lavender rough-lettered capsule, with the rest of the title in large plain sans beneath it.
visual_anatomy.layout: Eleven varied-size principle cards form a loose radial catalogue around a large grey circular centre, rather than a linear list or strict grid.
visual_anatomy.reading_order: Central idea and title → nearby cards around the circle → progressively outer cards, with size and placement creating a loose clockwise scan.
visual_anatomy.typography: Large title sans, one rough display accent, bold card headers, compact source-name chips, and smaller explanatory copy.
visual_anatomy.colour: Lavender, pink, aqua, and pale blue cards alternate around a neutral grey circular centre; a translucent diagonal beam occasionally crosses the board.
visual_anatomy.surface: Near-white ground, thin dark outlines, softly shaded central disc, gently raised cards, and limited shadow depth.
visual_anatomy.modules: Eleven principle cards with different aspect ratios, each pairing a rule title, an origin/source line, and a compact implication.
visual_anatomy.density: Medium-high: varied card sizes create a curated collection, but the central anchor prevents the items from reading as unrelated stickers.

motion.observed_state_change: The sampled intermediate frame shows a broad wipe/occlusion crossing the fixed board, while the near-complete frame restores the same card surround; no rule is activated, reordered, or transformed.
motion.motion_job: Attention reset and loop transition, not a semantic explanation of the radial catalogue.
motion.limitation: Three sampled frames establish the observed state change, not a frame-by-frame reconstruction of timing or platform playback.

transferable_mechanism.reader_job: Browse a recognisable set of peer ideas that all point back to one shared central concept.
transferable_mechanism.argument_shape: Radial catalogue around a single anchor.
transferable_mechanism.mechanism: Use a central anchor with repeated perimeter modules when every item has a direct, non-sequential relationship to the same core idea.
transferable_mechanism.use_condition: Use only when the hub-and-spoke relationship is real; do not use a radial arrangement to disguise an ordered process, hierarchy, or causal chain.

anti_copy_boundary: Do not reuse the source’s law selection, author/date attributions, radial card geometry, circular centre, palette, rough title tag, or full-board wipe treatment.

claim_boundary.note: The visual makes historical and explanatory assertions about named laws and their origins. The corpus does not independently verify those claims or the asserted caption pairing.
